common.governs: For people living in Indonesia, the Indonesian text of this page governs. For everyone else, the English text governs.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.who: shytalk.app is run by Shyden Labs, based in Indonesia. Shyden Labs decides what personal data is collected here and why.
privacy.what: When someone asks to join closed testing, the form keeps:
privacy.what2: the time the request was sent, and the time it was confirmed;
privacy.what3: the language the site was shown in.
privacy.whatAlso: The form also asks for confirmation of being 18 or older. Nothing else is asked for. The site sets no advertising or tracking cookies and runs no analytics scripts.
privacy.whatAddress: To stop the form being flooded, the visitor's internet address is used to count how many times the form is sent, for about a minute. It is not saved with the request.
privacy.why: To send one email with a link to the page that confirms the request, and, if a place in closed testing becomes available, to contact the person about it. The legal basis is consent, given by sending the form and confirming the email.
privacy.kept1: A request that is not confirmed within 48 hours is deleted the next time the list changes.
privacy.kept2: A confirmed request is kept only until closed testing ends, and then deleted.
privacy.kept3: A person who is not selected is not told, and their details are deleted when closed testing ends.
privacy.others: The data is stored with Cloudflare, which hosts the site. The confirmation email is sent through Oracle Cloud's email delivery service. Neither may use the data for anything else. Neither sells it, and Shyden Labs never sells it either. Both may handle it outside the person's own country, including outside Indonesia.
privacy.staff: Staff can see the closed-testing list only to run closed testing. Every time staff open or change it, a record is kept of who did it and when.
privacy.rights: Anyone who has used the form can, free of charge:
privacy.rights1: ask whether their data is held, and get a copy of it;
privacy.rights2: have it corrected, completed or deleted;
privacy.rights3: withdraw consent at any time, which deletes the request;
privacy.rights4: complain to a data protection authority, such as the one in their own country.
privacy.rightsLaw: These rights come from Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Law 27 of 2022, articles 6 to 9) and, for people in the European Union, the GDPR (articles 15 to 17).
privacy.contact: Requests go to support@shytalk.app. A copy or a correction is given within 72 hours of the request, as Indonesian law requires (Law 27 of 2022, articles 30 and 32).
privacy.changes: A new version of this policy shows its new date at the top. A change that collects more data, or uses it in a new way, is asked for again before it applies.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.about: shytalk.app tells people about ShyTalk, a place to learn languages and cultures by talking. It is run by Shyden Labs, based in Indonesia.
terms.testing: Sending the closed-testing form is a request, not a place. Sending it does not give access to the app. People who are selected are contacted by email and asked for more before they can join. Anyone who sends the form must be 18 or older.
terms.fair: Don't send the form for someone else without their agreement, send it in bulk, or try to break or overload the site.
terms.content: The site's words, images and video belong to Shyden Labs or are used with permission. They may be shared with a link back to the site; they may not be copied as someone else's work. ShyTalk's code is open source under the Apache 2.0 licence; the ShyTalk name and logo are trademarks and are not covered by that licence.
terms.noGuarantee: The site is offered as it is. Shyden Labs does its best to keep it working and correct, but cannot promise it will always be available.
terms.law: These terms are governed by the law of Indonesia. Nothing in them takes away a consumer's rights under the law of their own country.
terms.changes: A new version of these terms shows its new date at the top.
terms.contact: Questions about these terms go to support@shytalk.app.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.for: ShyTalk is a friendly place to learn languages and cultures by talking with people around the world. Everything on it serves that: practice, curiosity and respect.
guidelines.notDatingH: ShyTalk is not a dating app.
guidelines.notDating: Don't use it to look for romance, flirt, or ask people for dates, photos or private contact. Language partners are people who help each other learn. Accounts used for dating are removed.
guidelines.kind1: Treat every learner with patience. Everyone makes mistakes when learning a language.
guidelines.kind2: Correct gently, and only when it helps.
guidelines.kind3: Respect other cultures, beliefs and ways of speaking, even when they differ from yours.
guidelines.never1: Bullying, harassment, threats or hate, including about someone's accent, country, religion, gender or background.
guidelines.never2: Sexual content, or anything that puts a younger member at risk.
guidelines.never3: Spam, scams, selling, and sharing someone's personal details.
guidelines.never4: Pretending to be someone else, including staff.
guidelines.younger: Members of different ages are kept in separate spaces. Trying to reach a younger member outside those rules is never allowed and is reported.
guidelines.reporting: Anyone can report a person or a message. Staff review every report. Breaking these guidelines can lead to a warning, a mute, a suspension or a ban, depending on how serious it is.
